title: Console cost breakdown: switch to Cost Model API behind feature flag
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Console cost breakdown pages currently compute/request cost fields using a mix of legacy telemetry aggregations + inline heuristics, which do not always match billing hooks and have drift/definition mismatches (prefill vs decode, cache hits, overhead allocation, etc.).

This ticket migrates Console backend cost breakdown to call the internal Cost Model API v1 and render the canonical, versioned breakdown (and per-request estimate where needed), behind a feature flag with safe fallback to the legacy path.

Primary goals:
- Replace Console’s legacy cost breakdown computation with Cost Model API v1 responses for supported views.
- Ensure breakdown taxonomy matches ADR-022 (prefill/decode, cache, batching, overhead allocation, quantization deltas as applicable).
- Ship behind feature flag with staged rollout (dev -> staging -> prod small %) and clear rollback.
- Add metrics to compare legacy vs new output and track drift, latency impact, and error rates.

Non-goals:
- Changing customer-facing pricing or invoice calculations.
- Building new UI experiences; this is a backend data source swap + minimal response mapping.

References:
- Confluence PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/standard-cost-model-prd.json
- Design spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/cost-model-api-v1-design-spec.json
- API guidelines: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/api-standards/cost-model-api-guidelines.json
- ADRs: adr-021-standardize-cost-model-interfaces, adr-022-cost-breakdown-taxonomy
- Console mock payloads: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/product/console-and-rollouts/console-cost-breakdown-mock-data.json

Implementation notes (current plan):
1) Console backend calls cost-model-service using the shared client library (ENG-4830) with:
   - schema version negotiation (pin to v1 for initial rollout)
   - timeouts (<= 250ms per request on hot path; fall back if exceeded)
   - retries only for safe/idempotent endpoints and only if under request budget
2) Feature flag:
   - Flag name: console.cost_breakdown.use_cost_model_api
   - Default: off
   - Per-tenant allowlist + per-environment overrides
3) Fallback behavior:
   - If Cost Model API is unavailable, times out, or returns non-retryable errors, fallback to legacy breakdown (existing behavior) and emit a metric with error code.
   - If response is partial (bounded results) still render but annotate internal debug logs; do not break UI.
4) Caching:
   - Apply short-lived caching (e.g., 30–60s) for dashboard aggregate breakdown queries where request parameters are stable and cardinality is bounded.
   - No caching for per-request drilldowns where IDs are unique; rely on cost-model-service internal memoization.
5) Bounds/pagination:
   - Ensure Console requests remain within cost-model API bounding rules (time range limits, top-N dimensions, etc.).
   - Avoid “group-by everything” patterns that explode cardinality.

Scope: Console backend endpoints
- cost breakdown summary panels (by model, route, deployment mode)
- time series breakdown charts (bounded buckets)
- drilldown table for top contributors (bounded top-N)

Out of scope for v1 in Console:
- what-if projections (Optimize only)
- cost breakdown by arbitrary user-defined tags beyond the standard dimension set (needs v2 taxonomy + API support)

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Flagged path returns breakdown values populated from Cost Model API v1 for staging + prod.
- [ ] Console renders without regressions (no missing columns, stable totals) for supported views.
- [ ] Legacy vs new totals differ by <= 3% at p50 and <= 8% at p95 on the validation dataset/time windows, excluding known exceptions documented below.
- [ ] Added metrics:
      - cost_breakdown_source (legacy vs cost_model_api)
      - fallback_reason (timeout, 5xx, 4xx, schema_mismatch)
      - latency impact (p50/p95/p99 on Console endpoint)
      - “diff metrics” comparing legacy vs cost-model totals in shadow mode
- [ ] Rollout playbook documented in ticket + linked in release notes.

Known exceptions / intentional differences (must be documented as they come up):
- Overhead allocation: Console legacy path does not include certain shared overhead components; Cost Model v1 may include a request-attributable overhead line item depending on deployment mode and policy window.
- Telemetry lag: cost-model computations may differ from near-real-time legacy views when upstream token metering is delayed.

Risks:
- Latency regression for Console hot routes if cost-model calls are synchronous and uncached.
- Cardinality explosion if Console requests unbounded group-bys.
- Schema mismatches during early adoption (unknown fields / version negotiation).

Test plan:
- Unit tests: response mapping from Cost Model API -> Console DTOs (including missing optional fields).
- Integration tests: staging fixtures from golden datasets; verify deterministic output.
- Shadow mode: in prod, compute both legacy and cost-model outputs for a small % and emit diffs without changing UI (or internal-only headers/logs).
- Load test: exercise dashboard endpoints over typical query patterns; confirm overhead is within performance budget.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 0: dev/staging only, flag on by default in staging for internal tenants.
- Phase 1: prod allowlist (Redwood internal + 1–2 friendly customers) with shadow diffs enabled.
- Phase 2: ramp to 10% tenants, monitor latency/errors/drift dashboards.
- Phase 3: ramp to 50% then 100% after 1 week stable; keep legacy fallback for one full release cycle.

Links to related work:
- Client library: ENG-4830
- Drift SLI/alerts: ENG-4827
- Billing hooks alignment: ENG-4832
- GitHub PR (expected): pr-28470-console-cost-breakdown-switch-to-cost-model-api.json
comments: 2026-01-16 - Chloe Martin: Kicked off. Met w/ Jada + Felix to enumerate Console endpoints that currently compute cost breakdown. We have 3 primary read paths: (1) overview cards, (2) charts (bucketed), (3) top-N table. Will keep v1 scope to these; per-request drilldown is behind a separate flag and can follow once breakdown is stable.

2026-01-18 - Jada Williams: Please ensure we do not introduce unbounded group-by (we’ve been burned by that on usage analytics). Cost Model API guidelines require bounded responses; Console should always request top-N for any dimensioned table and fixed bucket counts for charts.

2026-01-21 - Ethan Park: Cost-model-service endpoints are ready for Console integration in staging. Use client lib version >= 0.9.3 for version negotiation + default 200ms timeout; can override but keep Console request budget in mind. If you need “breakdown by route + model” together, use the composite dimension preset; don’t attempt multi-dimensional pivot in one call.

2026-01-24 - Felix Schneider: Reviewed mapping against the mock UI payload. UI expects: total_cost_usd, cost_by_stage (prefill/decode), cache_savings line item (can be negative), and overhead line item. We need to confirm whether overhead is returned as separate category or included in total only. Please keep behavior consistent across breakdown table and tooltips.

2026-01-29 - Chloe Martin: Implemented initial adapter layer (CostModelBreakdownAdapter) and wired it into the dashboard aggregation path under console.cost_breakdown.use_cost_model_api. Added explicit guardrails: max_time_range=7d, max_buckets=200, top_n=50. Any requests exceeding bounds force legacy path + emit metric.

2026-02-02 - Logan Wright: Heads up: telemetry lag can cause cost-model results to be “late” vs legacy UI for the last ~5–10 minutes in peak periods. Suggest: (a) annotate internal debug logs with metering watermark, (b) consider excluding last 15 minutes from comparisons in shadow diff metrics.

2026-02-05 - Rafael Mendes: From SRE perspective, make sure Console fallback is robust. Please emit a single structured metric/event per fallback with reason + cost-model status code. Also ensure timeouts are fail-fast; don’t stack retries and blow up overall endpoint latency.

2026-02-09 - Chloe Martin: Shadow diff mode added for allowlisted tenants: call cost-model API asynchronously after responding (best-effort) and record diff metrics. This avoids doubling synchronous latency while still giving us comparison data.

2026-02-12 - Kaitlyn Nguyen: Confirmed auth/tenancy: Console backend uses service identity with tenant context forwarded; ensure we pass organization_id + environment scope so cost-model-service can enforce isolation. Please avoid sending raw prompt content; only metering IDs + aggregated telemetry refs.

2026-02-14 - Chloe Martin: Staging verification: breakdown renders correctly for internal tenant. Noted 4–6% delta on totals when overhead allocation is enabled (expected per FP&A policy). Added internal note + link to overhead policy thread (Laura Bennett email 2026-02-06).

2026-02-18 - Marissa Cole: Product ask: if cost-model path is enabled and overhead line appears, ensure UI label is consistent (“Allocated overhead”) and tooltip links to internal docs for support. We’ll keep customer-facing copy minimal but need internal-facing explanation for support escalations.

2026-02-20 - Chloe Martin: Opened PR updating Console backend to call Cost Model API for breakdown pages behind flag; includes fallback + metrics. Requesting review from Ethan (API), Jada (Console BE), Rafael (SRE).

2026-02-22 - Ethan Park: Reviewed PR. Main feedback: (1) pin schema_version=v1 explicitly in requests; don’t rely on default during rollout, (2) ensure time bucket alignment matches API semantics (inclusive/exclusive), (3) treat schema_mismatch as fallback_reason distinct from 4xx. Approved with changes.
